assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code PR-204.
The denied service is CPT code 93226.
CPT 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
The payer letter describes the service as not covered under the member's benefit plan.
A clinical indication note exists and documents the patient's history.
The patient has a history of recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has episodes of dizziness.
The patient had a recent event of syncope.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management.
The submitted diagnosis codes are I47.1, R42, and R55.
The diagnosis codes accompany this claim (were submitted with the claim).
Reprocessing of the outstanding balance is requested.
